name: Classroom
tagline: Warm paper, deep teal and sunny amber: a clear, friendly lesson deck.

palette.description: warm paper with deep teal headings and a sunny amber accent

typography.style: soft serif headlines over a clean sans; readable from the back of a room

best_for: Teaching anything step by step: school lessons, staff training, workshops, onboarding modules and explainers. Has slides for objectives, a key definition, three building blocks, a worked example, a comparison, a big fact, an activity, a quick quiz and a recap.
avoid_for: Sales pitches, investor decks and moody brand storytelling: it reads as a classroom by design.
